name: mkseo-ai-workspace
description: Shared checks for independent Python and TypeScript packages

scripts.check: pnpm deps:check && pnpm peers:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm presets:check && pnpm -C typescript check && pnpm check:python && pnpm semgrep
scripts.semgrep: semgrep scan --test --metrics off --disable-version-check .semgrep && semgrep scan --config .semgrep/security.yaml --error --strict --metrics off --disable-version-check python/src python/check.py typescript/src typescript/demo.ts scripts
